question: The lengths of the two sides of a triangle are 14 cm and 9 cm. Which of the options below can be the length of the third side?
solution:
**Given :**

Two sides of a triangle are 14cm and 9 cm

**Concept used :**

To form a triangle,

(a) The sum of any two sides of a triangle will be greater than the third side of that triangle.

(b) The difference of any two sides of a triangle will be smaller than the third side of that triangle.

**Solution:**

Checking option (1):

Condition (1)

⇒14 + 9 > 17 ⇒ 23 > 17

⇒14 + 17 > 9 ⇒ 31 > 9

⇒17 + 9 > 14 ⇒ 26 > 14

Condition (2)

⇒14 - 9 ⇒17 - 14 

⇒17 - 9 

Both the conditions are satisfied.

Checking option (2):

14 + 9 > 23 ⇒ 23 = 23

Condition (1) is not satisfied.

Checking option (3):

24 - 9 ⇒ 14 = 14

Condition (2) is not satisfied.

Checking option (4):

9 + 5 > 14 ⇒ 14 = 14

Condition (1) is not satisfied.

**∴ The length of the third side is 17 cm.**
